identities.name: Suffolk House, Penang
identities.address: 250 Jalan Ayer Itam, George Town, Penang, Malaysia

mapIdentity.scope: The current named building footprint fixes all four sides. The public-domain historic view and restoration record establish the wrapping galleries and recessed solid core.

note: Shown are the ground-floor open semicircular arcades, paired upper columns, dark timber doors, parapet and high center jack roof. The conservation record specifies limewash and clay tiles.
